sentences.en: Muslim traders from Arabia introduced Islam to Malaysia and Indonesia.
sentences.zh: 来自阿拉伯的穆斯林商人将伊斯兰教引入了马来西亚和印度尼西亚。

sentences.en: The protesters tore down the statue of a slave trader.
sentences.zh: 抗议者拆除了一个奴隶商人的雕像。

sentences.en: Sami began a lucrative career as a diamond trader.
sentences.zh: 萨米开始了作为钻石商人的一份高收入的职业。
